results.title: UPDATE: The bandits who invaded Birnin Tudu community in Gummi LGA, Zamfara State, have been chased away by local vigilantes.
results.description:
UPDATE: The bandits who invaded Birnin Tudu community in Gummi LGA, Zamfara State, have been chased away by local vigilantes.

Thankfully, no one was killed, injured or abducted, and no livestock was looted or rustled before the bandits fled.

Kudos to the vigilantes for standing up to the attackers and protecting their community. Their bravery and quick response deserve to be commended

results.title: SAD NEWS: This morning, bandits reportedly killed two people along the Adafka–Duhuwa road in Bukkuyum LGA, Zamfara State.
results.description:
SAD NEWS: This morning, bandits reportedly killed two people along the Adafka–Duhuwa road in Bukkuyum LGA, Zamfara State.

This afternoon, bandits also blocked a road from Lauwali Junction-Gusau town in Gusau LGA and shot a driver.

How long must residents and road users continue to live in fear before the authorities take decisive action to protect innocent lives?

results.description:
Road attacks.

Bandits attack commuters along Kaura-Birnin Magaji road, Manyaci-Anka road and Adabka-Duhuwa road, Zamfara State. Two bandits were killed during the Kaura-Birnin Magaji attack. Three people were abducted along the Anka-Manyaci road.
